summary: At {workplace}, the same maintenance jobs pass to a contractor's crew as the old crew loses employment.
realLife: At the Emeryville mill the contractor's employees took over maintenance on July 31, when the represented workers were discharged. The union set up a picket line that evening.
gates: The case record identifies the last day of employment and first contractor shift.
inGame: needs: last day of employment and first contractor shift.

turns.what: Workers can identify the first shift performed by the replacement crew.
The original crew covers another shift.
